description: UI components for sticker editing. Implements StickerPlacement.vue (single sticker renderer), StickerCanvas.vue (Moveable integration), StickerToolbar.vue (contextual controls), StickerTray.vue (library + upload UI), and StickerEditor.vue (top-level orchestrator with Decorate mode toggle and keyboard shortcuts). This feature provides the complete editing interface. Depends on FEAT-001 (types) and FEAT-002 (composables).
steps: Create frontend/src/components/journal/StickerPlacement.vue — renders single sticker with CSS transforms from normalized coords, props (placement, canvasWidth, canvasHeight, isSelected, viewMode), emits click to select, selection outline 2px dashed burgundy #7B0323 when selected and not viewMode

Create frontend/src/components/journal/StickerCanvas.vue — orchestrates all placements + Moveable component, props (placements, selectedId, viewMode, canvasEl), renders StickerPlacement for each, Moveable bound to selected element with draggable/resizable/rotatable/keepRatio/bounds config, emits update:placement on drag/resize/rotate, save-snapshot on dragEnd/resizeEnd/rotateEnd, select/deselect on clicks

Create frontend/src/components/journal/StickerToolbar.vue — contextual toolbar with icon buttons (Duplicate, Delete, Bring Forward/Back, To Front/Back, Rotate ±15°, Undo, Redo), props (selectedPlacement, canUndo, canRedo), emits action events, Cronevia aesthetic (cream bg, burgundy accents), disabled state when no selection

Create frontend/src/components/journal/StickerTray.vue — responsive library UI (desktop: 280px side panel, mobile: bottom sheet), tabs (Library, My Stickers) using radix-vue Tabs, grid of stickers (4 columns), Upload button, uses useStickerAssets composable, emits add-sticker and close, styled in Cronevia aesthetic

Create frontend/src/components/journal/StickerEditor.vue — top-level orchestrator, props (entryId, viewMode), Decorate mode toggle, renders StickerCanvas/StickerTray/StickerToolbar when decorateMode=true, keyboard shortcuts (Delete, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z, arrow keys), uses useStickerEditor composable, loads placements on mount, emits dirty-change and placements-change
acceptance_criteria: All 5 components exist in frontend/src/components/journal/ and compile without errors
StickerCanvas correctly integrates Moveable library (drag/resize/rotate work)
StickerToolbar buttons trigger correct composable functions
StickerTray displays builtin stickers in Library tab, user stickers in My Stickers tab, upload flow works
StickerEditor keyboard shortcuts function correctly (Delete removes selected, Ctrl+Z undoes, arrows nudge)
Responsive layout: desktop shows side tray, mobile shows bottom sheet
View mode renders placements without selection outlines or editing controls
Cronevia aesthetic maintained (cream #f5ebdd, burgundy #7B0323, pastels, restrained shadows)
verification: cd frontend && npm run build — all components compile
cd frontend && npm run dev — open journal editor, click Decorate toggle, verify tray opens, add sticker, drag/resize/rotate works, toolbar buttons work, keyboard shortcuts work
